changes: Google credit support for the $19bn Anthropic lease announced 4 November, applying once the lease commences: mandatory lease assumption or debt-reducing termination payment; no upfront equity to Google; cost recoverable from the tenant; falls away on Anthropic investment-grade ratings. No dollar cap disclosed.
CB-4 rent: 102 MW still billing at 30 September; phased November to December, against a late-September first hall in August.
Justified completions now late 2027 through 2Q28, from 2H27 to early 2028; Fluor GMP EPC signed, GMP still being set, design at 90%.
Revenue beat, yet interest of $53.6mn is 70% of revenue and adjusted EBITDA stayed negative at -$12.8mn.
Revolver rises to $400mn when the CB-4 lease commences ($150mn today, $75mn used); $280mn of Abernathy proceeds still to come; parent cash about $1.1bn.

consensus_thesis: A power-rich landlord whose contracted MW become debt capacity once investment-grade credit stands behind the tenant, valued on 2027-28 rent rather than this quarter.
headline: The consensus view holds and its largest overhang has eased, because Google agreed to backstop the Anthropic lease with no incremental upfront equity, but credit quality only improves once the Justified debt prices, CB-4's first rent moved later, and Justified's end date moved to 2Q28.
kona: Management says debt needs investment-grade support, and even a $19bn lease with a top lab needed Google behind it; Kona's tenant at tens of megawatts should expect the same or pay for it. The structure is worth copying in smaller form: assumption or termination payment on default, wrap cost charged to the tenant, no equity given away. GMP EPC contracts are the second lender ask.

sections.body: Emphasized more: investment-grade as a requirement on every lease, GMP contracts, Lake Mariner cost inside guidance. Emphasized less or dropped: mining (no call discussion; revenue $13.2mn); Morgantown only when asked; current pricing, on which the CEO told analysts not to focus. KPIs now matter more: MW billing by date, rent excluding pass-through ($46.0mn of revenue). Less: GAAP net income ($709.9mn on a $728.4mn warrant gain and $95mn Abernathy gain). Risks up: rate-and-spread exposure until Justified prices, though management cites contractual protections. Risks down: tenant credit at Justified from lease commencement.

sections.title: Major risks

sections.body: Liquidity: $2.36bn cash and restricted, $1.1bn at the parent (about $300mn behind Muskie LCs). Adds: revolver to $400mn on CB-4 commencement, $150mn by 31 December and about $130mn by 30 April from Abernathy. Against: $491.5mn short-term converts and $567mn of accrued construction and payables. Dilution: shares 501.4mn vs 420.1mn at year-end (+19.4%); warrant liability $1.09bn. Stock $10.44 at 9:54 ET on 6 November (24/7 Wall St.), about $5.2bn market cap, after a 30% slide in a month. Per-share read: $700mn of run-rate lease revenue against about $3.4bn of net debt today, before Justified's debt. Our implied Anthropic rent is about $197 per kW-month over the term ($19bn / 20 years / 401 MW).

head: Question
Asked on the call?
rows: Credit. You said credit support protects against Anthropic default. What share of 20-year rent or debt does Google cover, and when does it end relative to debt maturity?
Credit. What all-in coupon and recourse do you expect on Justified, and what if Anthropic's ratings end the wrap while spreads are wide?
Equity. You will not dilute at these levels. What is the $ gap to fund Muskie, and will you settle the $491.5mn converts in cash?
Byrd asked; no sizes. Converts not asked.
Delivery. CB-4 had a late-September hall in August. Which hall began rent, on what date, and is any Justified date set by the tenant?
Pricing. Twice you declined to give current yields. What rent per kW-month would Muskie clear today?

versus: Quarter: beat on revenue ($76.2mn vs $64.3mn Yahoo, from preview; $63.34mn per 24/7 Wall St.), but HPC rent proper was $46.0mn. Outlook: in line, as CB-4 stays in the fourth quarter though its first hall moved past late September and Justified now runs to 2Q28.
